arguments.where_clause: merchant_location_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchant_locations WHERE city = 'Rome' AND state = 'Italy')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant location is in Rome, Italy, regardless of amount, card or type. You can check the flagged set month by month from the transaction dates.
assumptions: Location matched on city = 'Rome' and state = 'Italy' exactly, case-sensitive, as the listed values are stored. Other Romes (for example in Georgia or New York) are not included.
The rule matches on merchant_location_id, the location of the transaction, not on the merchant's general location.
Month-by-month checking is done by filtering on transaction date; the rule itself has no date condition.
